panels.title: Models in use

panels.description: All catalog routes ranked by projected $/M (blended cost of the route's 7-day token mix at current asks; cached input billed at 10%; no-traffic routes use a 0.75/0.25 in/out mix). Tier: green = in use (>=100 billed reqs/7d), yellow = light, gray = catalog/probe-only. Cache green = high, TTFT green = fast.

targets.rawSql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT model, sum(prompt_tokens)::float AS tin, sum(completion_tokens)::float AS tout,
         sum(cached_tokens)::float/NULLIF(sum(prompt_tokens),0) AS hr
  FROM usage_logs WHERE is_probe = false AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1
), u24 AS (
  SELECT model, count(*) AS req FROM usage_logs
  WHERE is_probe = false AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1
), base AS (
  SELECT rm.route, rm.ask_in, rm.ask_out, rm.iq, rm.supports_cache,
    COALESCE(agg.tin,0) AS tin, COALESCE(agg.tout,0) AS tout, COALESCE(agg.hr,0) AS hr,
    COALESCE(u24.req,0) AS req24,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(u24.req,0) >= 100 THEN 'in use'
         WHEN COALESCE(u24.req,0) > 0 THEN 'probed'
         ELSE 'catalog' END AS tier
  FROM route_metrics rm
  LEFT JOIN agg ON agg.model = rm.route
  LEFT JOIN u24 ON u24.model = rm.route
  WHERE rm.iq IS NOT NULL AND rm.ask_in > 0
), px AS (
  SELECT base.*,
    CASE WHEN tin+tout > 0
      THEN ( tin*((1-hr)*ask_in + hr*0.1*ask_in) + tout*ask_out ) / (tin+tout)
      ELSE 0.75*ask_in + 0.25*ask_out END AS projected
  FROM base
  WHERE true
)
SELECT px.route AS "Route",
  round(px.projected::numeric,4) AS "Projected $/M",
  round(px.iq / NULLIF(px.projected,0)) AS "IQ per $",
  round(px.ask_in::numeric,4) AS "Ask in $/M",
  round(px.ask_out::numeric,4) AS "Ask out $/M",
  round(px.iq) AS "AA IQ",
  CASE px.tier WHEN 'in use' THEN 2 WHEN 'probed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Tier",
  u.reqs AS "Reqs (7d)",
  u.tok AS "Tokens (7d)",
  u.cache_pct AS "Cache %",
  u.ttft AS "TTFT ms",
  u.cost AS "Cost $",
  u.realized AS "Realized $/M"
FROM px
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT model,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe) AS reqs,
    sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe) AS tok,
    round(100.0*sum(cached_tokens) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe)/NULLIF(sum(prompt_tokens) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe),0),1) AS cache_pct,
    round(avg(ttft_ms) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe)) AS ttft,
    round(sum(cost_usdc) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe)::numeric,4) AS cost,
    round((sum(cost_usdc) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe)/NULLIF(sum(prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_probe),0)*1e6)::numeric,4) AS realized
  FROM usage_logs WHERE created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1
) u ON u.model = px.route
ORDER BY px.projected ASC NULLS LAST

panels.description: Requests per model, bucket size auto-scales with the time range (short range = finer buckets). Only models in use (>=100 billed reqs in range) are shown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from u.created_at) / ($__interval_ms/500.0)) * ($__interval_ms/500.0)) AS "time", u.model AS model, count(*) AS reqs FROM usage_logs u JOIN (SELECT model AS m2 FROM usage_logs WHERE is_probe = false AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 100) f ON f.m2 = u.model WHERE u.is_probe = false AND $__timeFilter(u.created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: TTFT ms by model (in use)

panels.description: Top 40 cheapest routes with AA IQ data by billed ask-in price. Full 88-route list with IQ lives in the table panel below. Data: route_metrics, refreshed hourly.

targets.rawSql:
WITH u24 AS (
  SELECT model, count(*) AS req FROM usage_logs
  WHERE is_probe = false AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1
), base AS (
  SELECT rm.route, rm.ask_in,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(u24.req,0) >= 100 THEN 'in use'
         WHEN COALESCE(u24.req,0) > 0 THEN 'probed'
         ELSE 'catalog' END AS tier
  FROM route_metrics rm
  LEFT JOIN u24 ON u24.model = rm.route
  WHERE rm.ask_in IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT route AS "route",
  CASE WHEN tier='in use'  THEN ask_in END AS "in use",
  CASE WHEN tier='probed'  THEN ask_in END AS "probed",
  CASE WHEN tier='catalog' THEN ask_in END AS "catalog"
FROM base
WHERE true
ORDER BY ask_in
LIMIT 48
